segments.summary: Reviewed every Docker, registry/auth, and Unraid control inventory line; the controls are consistently owner-adjudicated concept lineage without production wiring.
Reviewed every Unraid tail, orchestrator-phase, and interview/review control line; generic labels and absent bindings leave control semantics opaque.
Reviewed every interview numeric and Verification & HITL control line; authority-bearing selector semantics lack production policy and oracle contracts.
Reviewed every Accounts, Providers, and Diagnostics control line; credential and operational lifecycle behavior is not production-bound.
Reviewed every diagnostics tail, workspace cleanup, orphaned-worktree recovery, and storage/retention control line; destructive and restorative safety semantics are absent.
Reviewed every Global Rules, Per-Tool Defaults, and Access Control line; authority precedence and enforcement remain unwired, and a local-path example is fixture-only.
Reviewed every Browser Permissions, restart/recovery, and persona-management control line; the source expressly requires a command or retirement before implementation.
Reviewed every default-persona, tools/skills, and plugin control line; execution-bearing values lack production schemas, bounds, consumers, and wiring evidence.
